If you're excited about the potential AI has to shape human creativity and social interactions, join us in building the future! About the Role: We’re looking for a Member of Technical Staff with hands‑on experience building large‑scale video generation models—from data and training to distillation and acceleration into a fast, production‑ready model. Our models are human‑centric and product‑oriented: think interactive characters that can respond to text/audio/image inputs and generate video with very low latency.
